humanpen-humanpen-skill-root.description: Humanize document files with HumanPen to lower their AI-detection score. Rewrite a whole .docx/.pptx, or only the passages a Turnitin/iThenticate AI report flagged, while keeping every fact, number, citation, table and formula intact. Also converts citations to one style (APA, MLA, IEEE, GB/T 7714), condenses a document to a word budget, and translates while preserving layout. Use when the user points at a document FILE (.docx/.pptx; translate also takes .pdf/.xlsx/.epub/.html/.txt) or such an AI report and wants any of these; not for text pasted into chat.
